Elena (Solaris): Hi Redwood — Solaris wants to onboard a finetuned 13B claims summarizer, quantized to 8-bit. Must be PHI-safe, VPC-only, customer-managed HSM (Azure Key Vault HSM), and pre-prod safety evals. Target start Q2. Next steps? cc @Maria (CS)
Maria (CS): Quick clarifying q's: will any training data leave your VPC? peak qps & latency SLO? Private or Dedicated?
Elena (Solaris): All inference data stays in our VPC. We'll share scrubbed sample payloads. Peak ~500 qps (initial canary 20 qps). Latency target <=350ms p95. We prefer Private with HSM.
Maria (CS): Looping in Priya (safety/evals), Jae (deployment), Omar (security), Lin (rollout).
Priya (ML): For safety we'll need ~1k red-team prompts, 500 benign prompts, ~200 labeled summaries if possible. We'll run leakage scans, hallucination checks, ROUGE and policy checks. Secure S3 presigned URL to VPC endpoint preferred.
Elena (Solaris): Can provide scrubbed 1k in 48h via presigned VPC S3.
Jae (Solutions): Confirm artifact format (HF .safetensors, gguf, etc.) and quant recipe/version. Contexts? We'll need checksums for Private. Expected artifact: claims_summarizer_v1.safetensors.
Elena (Solaris): Correct — safetensors, quantized with intel/q8-recipe v0.9, contexts ~2k.
Omar (Security): HSM noted. Need SOC2 excerpt, KMS key policy, and region (eu-west-1). Customer-managed HSM adds ~2 weeks for provisioning — potential schedule risk.
Lin (EngOps): I'll create a project and propose rollout: eval -> staging deploy -> 24h safety canary (5%) -> ramp 25% -> 100%.
deploy-bot: Created task https://rwd.company/tasks/77421 "Solaris claims summarizer intake" assigned Maria, Priya, Jae, Omar, Lin :white_check_mark:
Maria (CS): Renewal note — customer is deciding between Dedicated vs Private; success here influences multi-year commit. I'll capture enablement feedback during kickoff.
Elena (Solaris): Kickoff request next Wed 10:00 UTC. SOC2 excerpt and perf CSV incoming.
Priya (ML): With samples we'll run initial bench in ~3 business days and deliver a safety report with guardrails (filters, sanitizers, thresholds).
Jae (Solutions): If you can share perf CSV (latency/token) it helps sizing.
Elena (Solaris): Will share perf CSV.
Lin (EngOps): Action items: Maria to collect SOW & legal contact; Jae to validate artifact acceptance; Priya to prep eval harness; Omar to start HSM checklist; Lin to schedule kickoff and board.
Maria (CS): I'll DM SOW template and legal request to @Elena. :handshake:
Elena (Solaris): Thanks — appreciate the fast turnaround. Looking forward to kickoff. :rocket:
